verses.en: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
verses.pt: O ancião à senhora eleita, e a seus filhos, aos quais eu amo em verdade, e não somente eu, mas também todos os que conhecem a verdade,
verses.en_web: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all those who know the truth;
verses.en_bbe: I, a ruler in the church, send word to the noble sister who is of God's selection, and to her children, for whom I have true love; and not only I, but all who have knowledge of what is true;

verses.en: For the truth’s sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
verses.pt: por causa da verdade que permanece em nós, e para sempre estará conosco:
verses.en_web: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
verses.en_bbe: Because of this true knowledge which is in us, and will be with us for ever:

verses.en: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.pt: Graça, misericórdia, paz, da parte de Deus Pai e da parte de Jesus Cristo, o Filho do Pai, serão conosco em verdade e amor.
verses.en_web: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.en_bbe: May grace, mercy, and peace be with us from God the Father, and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in all true love.

verses.en: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
verses.pt: Muito me alegro por ter achado alguns de teus filhos andando na verdade, assim como recebemos mandamento do Pai.
verses.en_web: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
verses.en_bbe: It gave me great joy to see some of your children walking in the true way, even as we were ordered to do by the Father.

verses.en: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
verses.pt: E agora, senhora, rogo-te, não como te escrevendo um novo mandamento, mas aquele mesmo que desde o princípio tivemos: que nos amemos uns aos outros.
verses.en_web: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
verses.en_bbe: And now, my sister, I make a request to you, not sending you a new law, but the law which we had from the first, that we have love for one another.

verses.en: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
verses.pt: E o amor é este: que andemos segundo os seus mandamentos. Este é o mandamento, como já desde o princípio ouvistes, para que nele andeis.
verses.en_web: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
verses.en_bbe: And love is the keeping of his laws. This is the law which was given to you from the first, so that you might keep it.

verses.en: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
verses.pt: Porque já muitos enganadores saíram pelo mundo, os quais não confessam que Jesus Cristo veio em carne. Tal é o enganador e o anticristo.
verses.en_web: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
verses.en_bbe: Because a number of false teachers have gone out into the world, who do not give witness that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. Such a one is a false teacher and Antichrist.

verses.en: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
verses.pt: Olhai por vós mesmos, para que não percais o fruto do nosso trabalho, antes recebeis plena recompensa.
verses.en_web: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
verses.en_bbe: Keep watch over yourselves, so that you do not make our work of no effect, but may get your full reward.

verses.en: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
verses.pt: Todo aquele que vai além do ensino de Cristo e não permanece nele, não tem a Deus; quem permanece neste ensino, esse tem tanto ao Pai como ao Filho.
verses.en_web: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ, doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching, the same has both the Father and the Son.
verses.en_bbe: Anyone who goes on and does not keep to the teaching of Christ, has not God: he who keeps to the teaching has the Father and the Son.

verses.en: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
verses.pt: Se alguém vem ter convosco, e não traz este ensino, não o recebais em casa, nem tampouco o saudeis.
verses.en_web: If anyone comes to you, and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
verses.en_bbe: If anyone comes to you not having this teaching, do not take him into your house or give him words of love:

verses.en: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
verses.pt: Porque quem o saúda participa de suas más obras.
verses.en_web: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
verses.en_bbe: For he who gives him words of love has a part in his evil works.

verses.en: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
verses.pt: Embora tenha eu muitas coisas para vos escrever, não o quis fazer com papel e tinta; mas espero visitar-vos e falar face a face, para que o nosso gozo seja completo.
verses.en_web: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.
verses.en_bbe: Having much to say to you, it is not my purpose to put it all down with paper and ink: but I am hoping to come to you, and to have talk with you face to face, so that your joy may be full.

verses.en: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
verses.pt: Saúdam-te os filhos de tua irmã, a eleita.
verses.en_web: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: The children of your noble sister, who is of God's selection, send you their love.
